name: OpenClonk
description: Daily HTTPS update check, but the downloaded .ocu/installer has zero signature check and is run elevated via ShellExecute(...,'runas',...) / execl. Arguably D.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The update downloads a server-provided package and passes it to ApplyUpdate, which extracts and executes the update program without an integrity verifier.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | OpenClonk | https://github.com/openclonk/openclonk.git | 36de799544af0459014ea088867fe263779a8bdd / 2026-04-28 | Y | Y (auto-checks once/day: `Config.Network.LastUpdateTime`, `src/gui/C4UpdateDlg.cpp:305-309`; download+apply requires one user Yes/No prompt) | Y | https for the version-check query (`Config.Network.UpdateServerAddress` default `https://www.openclonk.org/update/`, `src/config/C4Config.cpp:189`); actual package download URL comes from the **server's response** and is used mostly as-is — `DoUpdate()` only strips a literal `"http://"` prefix (`src/gui/C4UpdateDlg.cpp:164`, a no-op for https URLs) — no CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER/VERIFYHOST override anywhere in `src/network/C4HTTP.cpp` (default cert validation applies whenever https is actually used) | N | **none** — downloaded `.ocu` update package or installer executable is extracted/run directly with **zero hash or signature check** | N/A (no verifying key exists at all) | `src/gui/C4UpdateDlg.cpp:151-176` (`DoUpdate`: download via `C4DownloadDlg::DownloadFile`, then `ApplyUpdate`); `:178-293` (`ApplyUpdate`: extracts update program from the unverified `.ocu` via c4group and **executes it — on Windows via `ShellExecute(..., L"runas", ...)`, i.e. runs the downloaded update program elevated/as-admin with no integrity check**; on POSIX, `execl()`s it directly); `:302-382` (`CheckForUpdates`, HTTPS version-check query, `strQuery` at line 321). |
